original.target_description: Original main-study comparison of global recognition facilitation index between high and low alexithymia groups; ANOVA, journal p. 563 / PDF p. 13. This is the only eta-squared test on the supplied page.

n.sample_role: Participants in high and low alexithymia groups; analytic n for this ANOVA not established.
n.exclusions: No test-specific exclusions documented. Printed group counts on journal p. 558 are low N = 55 and high N = 52; the focal test reports F(1, 106), so analytic n cannot safely be established from these counts.

notes: Original locator p. 13 interpreted as PDF page 13 (journal p. 563), which contains one printed eta-squared ANOVA. The corresponding replication claim explicitly quotes the same original test. Requested replication d is not printed; reported partial eta squared retained without conversion. The original sample section prints low N = 55 and high N = 52, but the focal ANOVA has denominator df = 106; these were not converted into a fabricated analytic n. Replication analytic n is also not explicitly printed. Cached PDF extraction renders the equality sign as ¼ and eta-squared as h2; numerical precision retained.
